name: Sound lab
summary: The moving NASA rain and snow map as a mixing desk: choose which part of the weather drives pitch, loudness, overtones, instrument, chord and rhythm, with separate rain and snow sounds.
author: balona
description: A mapping playground on the moving NASA IMERG video. Voices follow storms, a scan line, points you drop, or the whole map; for each one the map gives X, Y, speed, spin, color, size and rain or snow, and a mapping table decides which of them drives pitch, amplitude, overtones, instrument (21 synthesized instruments), chord, rhythm, note length, pan and vibrato, with its own shape and range. Rain and snow each have their own key, scale and instruments, and a voice crossfades between them. Strict tuning keeps every note on the scale and on the beat. Storm Watch mode plays the storms tracked in the 7 November snapshots. From balona's sound_demo branch (version 1).
